card.name: Dose unit abbreviations and pJIA
card.fires_on: Short unit letters in dosing text, such as mg, g, ng and kg after a slash or bracket. Also the J in the abbreviation pJIA.

modes.label: Unit abbreviations
modes.description: Unit letters like mg, g or ng right after an opening bracket or in a rate expression.

modes.label: pJIA abbreviation
modes.description: The J inside pJIA (polyarticular juvenile idiopathic arthritis) in dosing lists.

modes.label: Spelled-out unit starts
modes.description: The first letters of a measure or a term in a formula, such as gl in glomerular or W in Wavelength.
